notes.title: Post release patch
notes.notes:
Hello my fellow traders! Lately we've been getting a lot of questions about CODE field in the settings. How to use it? What does it do?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759853/548358dbeb1e6766a32f303bc251c9018309ad1a.jpg

Well, the truth is - it doesn't do anything. Or perhaps I should say it DIDN'T do anything. It was a part of promotion campaing that got cancelled and unlike my exchange balance the feature just stayed there.

Today we're rolling out an update that will bring promo codes back to life. We've added several codes that permanently unlock new content (like new events/opportunities) in your game. We plan to distribute them via various means so keep an eye out in our Discord and Telegram changes.

https://discord.gg/q6RRS8a
https://t.me/cryptofall_game

Meanwhile I've got a little something for you. Entering the name of our other title  will unlock a small event about software startups.
